title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2603.02184v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-attribution learning (MAL), which enhances model performance by learning from conversion labels yielded by multiple attribution mechanisms, has emerged as a promising learning paradigm for conversion rate (CVR) prediction. However, the conversion labels in public CVR datasets are generated by a single attribution mechanism, hindering the development of MAL approaches.   To address this data gap, we establish the Multi-Attribution Benchmark (MAC), the first public CVR dataset featuring labels from multiple attribution mechanisms. Besides, to promote reproducible research on MAL, we develop PyMAL, an open-source library covering a wide array of baseline methods. We conduct comprehensive experimental analyses on MAC and reveal three key insights: (1) MAL brings consistent performance gains across different attribution settings, especially for users featuring long conversion paths. translated_title: MAC：一个包含多种归因机制下标签的转化率预测基准
translated_abstract: 多归因学习（MAL）通过从多种归因机制产生的转化标签中学习来提升模型性能，已成为转化率（CVR）预测中一种有前景的学习范式。然而，公开的CVR数据集中的转化标签仅由单一归因机制生成，这阻碍了MAL方法的发展。为填补这一数据空白，我们建立了多归因基准（MAC），这是首个包含来自多种归因机制标签的公开CVR数据集。此外，为促进MAL的可复现研究，我们开发了PyMAL，一个涵盖广泛基线方法的开源库。我们在MAC上进行了全面的实验分析，并揭示了三个关键洞察：（1）MAL在不同归因设置下带来一致的性能提升，尤其是对于具有较长转化路径的用户。（2）性能增长随……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了首个包含多种归因机制转化标签的公开转化率预测基准数据集MAC及配套开源库PyMAL，实验表明多归因学习在各种归因设置下均能带来一致的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAC, the first public CVR prediction benchmark featuring conversion labels under multiple attribution mechanisms, along with an open-source library PyMAL, demonstrating that multi-attribution learning consistently improves performance across different attribution settings.
